text:
Recommended comparison: retain each user’s paired hit indicators on identical pinned candidates; report per-category HR@10, gated-minus-baseline differences, and their equally weighted macro difference. Obtain a 95% paired bootstrap interval by resampling 200 user pairs within each category, then averaging four category differences; 10,000 CPU resamples require no retraining. Report discordant win/loss counts; exact McNemar tests can supplement category estimates. These quantify user-sampling uncertainty conditional on seed 42 and fixed candidates, excluding training-seed and negative-sampling uncertainty. Bootstrap/randomization methods have supporting [recommendation-evaluation evidence](https://piret.info/pubs/2023/SIGIR23-InferenceAtScale).

Predeclare a small ablation: corrected baseline, gated NextItNet with otherwise identical settings, and—only if budget permits—one gate-specific control, such as a learned constant gate replacing the input-dependent gate. Keep four categories, one model/category, seeds, epoch cap, batches and checkpoint-selection rule fixed. Cap validation inspections, log every attempted configuration and GPU cost, and select solely by macro HR@10. Treat intervals after adaptive selection as descriptive; bootstrapping cannot remove winner’s bias. Repeated optimization of finite validation estimates can produce substantial [selection overfitting](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v11/cawley10a.html).

Mean pairwise cosine can conceal low-dimensional collapse. On identical nonpadding item/history samples, add centered covariance spectra, top-eigenvalue variance fractions, effective rank exp(−Σp log p), and embedding-norm distributions; [dimensional-collapse research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.09348) motivates spectral inspection. Report positive-minus-hardest-negative and positive-minus-tenth-highest-negative logit margins, alongside candidate-logit standard deviations and standardized margins. Positive global rescaling enlarges raw margins without changing ranks, consistent with [temperature scaling](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/guo17a). Geometry and margins explain behavior; only paired benchmark HR@10 supports recommendation gains.
